title: RNAqueous with DNAse Clean-up by Phenol:Chloroform
author: Dan Richter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iskcecw
materials: On ice, add more lysis buffer undetermined

steps.title: Prepare Elution Solution
steps.instruction: Place elution solution in a dry bath at 70-80ºC.

steps.title: Resuspend and Lyse Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend and lyse the pellet using lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place pellet in a 50 mL conical tube on ice
Add lysis buffer
Pipette up and down 5 times to resuspend the pellet
Pipette up and down 20 times to fully resuspend/lyse pellet

steps.title: Verify Lysis
steps.instruction: Check for complete cell lysis using a microscope.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysate into two 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes
Take an aliquot from one tube and pipette onto a glass slide (keep slide in a petri dish to contain noxious smell)
Immediately centrifuge both tubes at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge at 1ºC for 5 min to pellet unlysed bacteria
During centrifugation, add a cover slip to the glass slide and confirm lysis using a microscope

steps.title: Mechanical Shearing
steps.instruction: Pass the lysate through a needle to ensure lysis.

substeps.instruction: On ice, pass the lysate in each tube 5 times through a 25 gauge needle fitted to an RNAse-free 1 mL syringe
If cells were not lysed, pass through the needle additional times and re-check lysis before continuing

steps.title: Filter RNA
steps.instruction: Filter the lysate/ethanol mixture through a filter cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Add 64% EtOH at room temperature (RT) per tube
Mix thoroughly by inverting the tubes several times
Transfer lysate/ethanol mixture from one Eppendorf tube to a single filter cartridge in a collection tube
Centrifuge at 15,000 xg, RT, for 30 sec or until the mixture is drawn through the filter
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation three additional times until all lysate/ethanol mixture from both tubes has been processed

steps.title: Wash Filter Cartridge
steps.instruction: Wash the filter cartridge with wash solutions.

substeps.instruction: Add wash solution #1 and centrifuge at 15,000 xg, RT, for 30 sec
Add wash solution #2/3 and centrifuge at 15,000 xg, RT, for 30 sec
Repeat the wash solution #2/3 step once
Centrifuge an additional 30 sec at 15,000 x g to remove residual wash solution #2/3

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA from the filter cartridge using pre-heated elution solution.

substeps.instruction: Place the filter cartridge in a new collection tube
Pipette pre-heated elution solution onto the filter and centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 30 sec
Pipette additional pre-heated elution solution onto the filter and centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 30 sec (final eluate volume should be ~45 uL)

steps.title: Quantify and Dilute RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and prepare dilutions for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Measure concentration on NanoDrop
Make a 1:5 dilution (2 µl RNA : 8 µl diluent) in a separate tube for PCR/Bioanalyzer
Take an aliquot of the 1:5 dilution and dilute to 1 ng/µL in a separate tube for Bioanalyzer
If concentration is >240 ng/uL (10ug/41.5 uL), dilute an aliquot to 240 ng/uL in 41.5 uL and save remainder at -80C

steps.title: DNAse Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA contamination using TURBO DNAse.

substeps.instruction: Add 10X TURBO DNAse buffer
Add TURBO DNAse and mix gently
Incubate at 37ºC for 30 min

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Purify RNA using phenol:chloroform and chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extractions.

substeps.instruction: Add water to bring volume to 400 µL
Add 3 M sodium acetate at pH = 5.2 (final concentration 0.3 M, 1/10 volume)
Add phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol at pH = 8 (2 volumes)
Shake vigorously inside fume hood for 15 sec
Centrifuge at max speed in a microcentrifuge for 2 min (check for insoluble precipitate indicating potassium salts > 20 mM)
Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new tube
Add chloroform:isoamyl alcohol at pH = 8 (2 volumes)
Shake vigorously inside fume hood for 15 sec
Centrifuge at max speed in a microcentrifuge for 2 min
Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new tube

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate and wash the RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add GlycoBlue (final amount ~25 µg, working stock 15 µg/µL)
Add 100% EtOH (2.5 volumes)
Shake vigorously to mix
Centrifuge at max speed in a microcentrifuge for 10 min
Decant ethanol and remove residual with pipette
Wash with -20ºC 70% EtOH
Centrifuge for 5 min at 4ºC

steps.title: Final Recovery and Stabilization
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA and stabilize with SUPERase-In.

substeps.instruction: Dry pellet and resuspend in water
Measure concentration on NanoDrop and dilute RNA to 1 ng/µL in a separate tube for Bioanalyzer
Add SUPERase-In (at 20 U / µl, final concentration 1 U / µl)
